name: Bodyweight Squat
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart. Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower until thighs are parallel to the floor (or as low as comfortable), then stand back up.
coaching_cue: Keep your chest tall and push your knees out over your toes. Press through your whole foot to stand.
common_mistakes: Knees caving inward, heels lifting, leaning too far forward.
modification: Squat to a chair or use a countertop for balance support.
advanced_progression: Add dumbbells to perform a goblet squat.

name: Goblet Squat
instructions: Hold a dumbbell vertically at chest height with both hands. Squat down, keeping your elbows inside your knees, then stand back up.
coaching_cue: The weight at your chest helps you stay upright — use it as a counterbalance.
common_mistakes: Letting the weight pull you forward, not going deep enough, knees caving.
modification: Use a lighter weight or squat to a bench.
advanced_progression: Increase weight or add a 2-second pause at the bottom.

name: Split Squat
instructions: Stand in a staggered stance with one foot about 2 feet ahead of the other. Lower your back knee toward the floor, then press through your front foot to stand.
coaching_cue: Keep most of your weight on your front foot and your torso upright.
common_mistakes: Stance too narrow, front knee drifting past toes excessively, leaning forward.
modification: Hold a chair or wall for balance.
low_impact_alternative: Supported split squat with hands on a wall.

name: Sumo Squat
instructions: Stand with feet wider than shoulder-width, toes turned out about 45 degrees. Hold a dumbbell in front of you. Lower straight down by bending your knees, then press back up.
coaching_cue: Push your knees out in the direction of your toes and keep your torso upright.
common_mistakes: Letting knees collapse inward, leaning forward, not going low enough.
modification: Bodyweight only or hold a chair for balance.
advanced_progression: Heavier dumbbell or add a pulse at the bottom.

name: Step-Up
instructions: Stand in front of a bench or sturdy step. Step one foot up onto the bench and press through that foot to stand fully on top. Step back down with control.
coaching_cue: Drive through the heel of the working leg. Avoid pushing off the back foot.
common_mistakes: Using the back leg to push off, leaning forward, choosing a step that's too high.
modification: Use a lower step and hold a wall or railing for balance.
low_impact_alternative: Use a lower step height (6-8 inches).
advanced_progression: Hold dumbbells at your sides or increase step height.

name: Wall Sit
instructions: Lean your back flat against a wall and slide down until your thighs are parallel to the floor (or as low as comfortable). Hold the position.
coaching_cue: Press your lower back into the wall and keep your weight in your heels.
common_mistakes: Thighs not parallel, pushing knees past toes, holding breath.
modification: Don't go as deep — keep a higher angle at the knees.
advanced_progression: Hold a dumbbell on your thighs or extend one leg at a time.

name: Reverse Lunge
instructions: Stand tall. Step one foot backward and lower your back knee toward the floor until both knees form approximately 90-degree angles. Press through your front foot to return to standing.
coaching_cue: Keep your torso upright and front knee tracking over your toes. Step far enough back to avoid the front knee traveling forward.
common_mistakes: Front knee caving inward, torso leaning forward, stepping too short.
modification: Hold a chair or wall for balance, or reduce depth.
low_impact_alternative: Supported reverse lunge holding a chair.
